preconditions: both objects begin supported by the ground and spatially separated
both dogs begin empty-mouthed and spatially distinguishable
ordered_milestones: the acting dog lowers or brings its muzzle toward the selected object
the acting dog's muzzle or mouth contacts that same selected object
the acting dog grips that same selected object and lifts it from its supporting surface
the acting dog raises or withdraws its head while retaining that same selected object
action_program.reverse_action_definition: from the same empty-mouth grounded-object precondition, the primary dog contacts and pushes the primary object along the ground without gripping or lifting it, then raises its head empty and remains empty-mouthed

scene_levels.scene_phrase: an open area of gray concrete in soft natural daylight

templates.full_action: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. {actor_ref} lowers its muzzle to {object_ref}, grips it, lifts it clear, raises its head, and holds it through the end; {distractor_actor_ref} stays still and {distractor_object_ref} remains down.
templates.noop: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. {actor_ref} and {distractor_actor_ref} remain still and separate; neither touches {object_ref} or {distractor_object_ref}, and both objects stay down.
templates.incomplete_action: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. {actor_ref} lowers its muzzle to sniff and briefly touch {object_ref} but never grips or lifts it; {distractor_actor_ref} and {distractor_object_ref} remain still.
templates.reverse_action: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. Keeping that initial condition, {actor_ref} lowers to {object_ref}, contacts and pushes it away along the ground without gripping or lifting, then raises its head empty and remains empty-mouthed; {distractor_actor_ref} and {distractor_object_ref} stay still.
templates.shuffled_action: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. {actor_ref} raises its empty head, nudges {object_ref}, lowers only afterward, and withdraws without holding it; {distractor_actor_ref} and {distractor_object_ref} stay still.
templates.wrong_actor: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. {distractor_actor_ref}, not {actor_ref}, lowers to {object_ref}, grips it, lifts it, raises its head, and holds it through the end; {distractor_object_ref} remains down.
templates.wrong_object: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. {actor_ref} lowers to {distractor_object_ref}, grips it, lifts it, raises its head, and holds it through the end; {distractor_actor_ref} stays still and {object_ref} remains down.
templates.camera_only: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. The viewpoint alone makes a smooth orbit and tilt while {actor_ref}, {distractor_actor_ref}, {object_ref}, and {distractor_object_ref} remain fixed and separate.
templates.appearance_only: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. Only the coat color and texture of {actor_ref} change; {distractor_actor_ref}, {object_ref}, {distractor_object_ref}, all poses, and the viewpoint stay fixed.
templates.generic_wrong_motion: At the start, {camera} shows {actor} and {distractor_actor}, both empty-mouthed, beside {object} and {distractor_object} resting apart in {scene}. In four clear events, {actor_ref} steps left, turns toward the camera, crouches, and rises, matching the target clip's gross motion without approaching either object; {distractor_actor_ref}, {object_ref}, and {distractor_object_ref} stay still.
